summary: Tested the Notion knowledge feature end to end. Backend: 20/20 pytest pass. Covered GET/connect/sync/delete, validation, fake-token 401 against the real Notion API, 'invalid' status that keeps the previous pages, multi-tenant isolation, cron auth, cron duplicate check and non-JSON body, the mock seed script (4 pages, cached second sync uses 4 calls vs 11), and the AI using Notion facts in /ai/test (EN + Khmer), the website widget chat and suggest. After disconnect the AI no longer knows the Notion facts. Frontend: setup steps, link, password input, disabled button and error toasts. Connected view: workspace, status, hint, 4 pages with icons, chars and links. Sync now shows a spinner, then 'Secret no longer works' with the error and Reconnect form, and the pages are kept. Disconnect needs two clicks. The no-pages amber box shows. Save still works and doesn't affect the Notion link. No horizontal overflow at 390px. Voice vox-auto-connect still renders. Admin was re-seeded at the end (status ok, 4 pages). The loadtest business is disconnected.

minor.issue: No rate limit. Each call hits the real api.notion.com, so a logged-in user can use it to probe tokens or spam Notion. /notion/sync has 30/h but connect has nothing.
Any team member (role member) can connect, replace or disconnect the business's Notion secret. This matches /settings, which also has no role check, but owner-only would be safer.

issues: The header still says 'Connected to Sunrise Coffee' next to the red 'Secret no longer works' pill. Minor wording mismatch.

action_items: Optional: add a rate limit to POST /api/notion/connect, e.g. 10/h per business
Optional: consider owner-only for Notion connect/disconnect

Note: all Notion page content goes into the prompt. In testing the AI told a customer the wifi password from the Notion page. Businesses should be told to share only customer-facing pages, e.g. with an extra line in the step-2 help text.
critical_code_review_comments: notion_view correctly excludes token_enc and knowledge. The secret is Fernet-encrypted and only the hint is exposed. Verified in tests.
sync_business returns early when the link is disconnected or replaced mid-sync. Safe, because a replaced link gets status queued and its own background task.
rate_ok is in-memory, so the limit is per process and resets on restart. Fine for a single worker.
Cron marks the admin demo link 'invalid' (mock secret vs real Notion) on every hourly run until it is re-seeded. Expected, but the demo state won't last past the next cron run.
seed_data_creation: admin@replyflow.com re-seeded via scripts/notion_mock_sync.py (connected, status ok, 4 pages). The loadtest+706ab4fd business was briefly given a synthetic 0-page link to test the no-pages box, then removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter10_notion.py re-seeds admin itself (it needs subprocess access to /app/scripts). The test_iter9 suite needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. 3 of its tests depend on an expired Cloudflare mock tunnel (louisiana-cancel-...trycloudflare.com) and fail for that reason only.
